The tumor is located in the left frontal lobe and involves the cortex and deep white matter. It demonstrates mild enhancement and does not show significant necrosis or edema. The absence of features suggestive of higher grade transformation (e.g., significant necrosis, extensive edema) supports a lower grade diagnosis within the IDH-mutant category.
